Thought: I need to analyze the properties of nitric acid to determine which of the given statements are true.

Nitric acid (HNO₃) is a highly corrosive mineral acid. Let me evaluate each option:

A. "it causes skin irritation only in concentrated form" - This is false. Nitric acid is corrosive and can cause skin irritation even in dilute forms, though the severity increases with concentration. Even dilute nitric acid can cause skin irritation.

B. "it is a reducing agent" - This is false. Nitric acid is not a reducing agent. In fact, it's known for being an oxidizing agent, as it can donate oxygen atoms to other substances in reactions.

C. "it is a strong oxidizing agent" - This is true. Nitric acid is a powerful oxidizing agent. It can oxidize many metals and non-metals, and is used in many oxidation reactions in chemistry.

Based on my analysis, only option C is correct.
